title: Graph Database Use Cases: Why and How Graph is being used for Data Harmonization and Analytics
description:
Graph analytics databases are being rapidly adopted for a variety of reasons. We outline what types of problems customers are solving, reasons why they are adopting graph analytics databases, the value they are getting and how Labelled Property Graphs (RDF*) with RDF is changing the use cases being addressed by RDF and graph technologies.

We will also show a short demo of how a graph analytics database with RDF* combines the expressive power of RDF with labelled properties to empower the user with new insights from diverse data at speeds and performance never before possible.

Presentation by Thomas Cook, Director Sales, Cambridge Semantics at Connected Data London 2019: https://connected-data.london/session... ---
